The *345th Pokemon* in the National Pokedex is *Cradily*. It is a *Rock/Grass type* Pokemon that was introduced in *Generation 3*, which is also known as the *Hoenn region*. Cradily is a *fossil Pokemon* that can be revived from a *Root Fossil* in the Pokemon games. It evolves from *Lileep* starting at level 40.
